description: We are a cross-border collective of data enthusiasts, designers, and creative technologists based across Bangladesh, Cambodia, and Vietnam. Living in three delta nations profoundly shaped by monsoons and climate shifts, we share a deep, firsthand connection to the changing rhythms of our skies. By blending our diverse strengths in data engineering, interactive design, and hardware/software crafting, we turn raw meteorological data from cities around the world into living melodies.
